message.reasoning:
We need to generate test cases for equals(double, double) static method. It returns true if absolute difference < 1e-12.

We need to cover branches: only one conditional. But we can test true and false cases, including edge cases near threshold, zero, negative numbers, NaN, infinities? The method uses Math.abs difference < 1e-12. For NaN, subtraction yields NaN, Math.abs(NaN) is NaN, comparison < returns false. So test that returns false for NaN inputs. Also test with infinities: difference is Infinity, abs Infinity, comparison false. Also test with values exactly equal: difference zero -> true.

Edge case: difference exactly 1e-12? Then abs diff = 1e-12, condition < 1e-12 is false. So test that returns false.

Also test with difference just below threshold: e.g., 1e-12 - epsilon. Use 0.5e-12.

Thus create group "equals(double, double)". Cases.

Input format: list of parameter objects with name and value. Parameter names: maybe "n1", "n2". Provide values as numbers.

Expected: true or false.
